amsterdam-veluwe-forest-and-ijssel-river.slogan: A 215 km loop out of Naarden fortress
amsterdam-veluwe-forest-and-ijssel-river.story: Forest lanes and river dikes without city clutter. A 215 km loop that starts and ends near Naarden, about 3 h 42 of riding. The stops in between: Veluwe forest roads, Deventer river stop and IJssel dike roads. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.
